title: Receive-only observation subscription profile
description: One source: the broker an observation ingester subscribes to and the topics it reads. A profile never names a topic to publish to, and carries no secret: the credential is named, never included.

name.description: The source identity carried by every capture from this profile.

ws_path.description: Only for transport websockets; /mqtt when absent.

verify.description: Certificate verification is never turned off by a profile.

qos.description: Subscriptions are QoS 0; an absent field means 0.

credential.description: Names of where the ingester reads the credential from (environment variables), never the values.

adapter.description: The payload format, read downstream: capture never parses.
